run:
node --version
if [ ! -f test/e2e-local/e2e.test.js ]; then echo 'SKIP: no e2e harness at this commit'; exit 0; fi
rc=0
node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=tap --test-reporter-destination="$RUNNER_TEMP/e2e.tap" test/e2e-local/*.test.js || rc=$?
node scripts/laptop-ci/e2e-summary.js "$RUNNER_TEMP/e2e.tap" "$RUNNER_TEMP/e2e-summary.json" || { [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] || rc=1; }
exit $rc
note: End-to-end harness against a local instance in WSL; stub Hermes on loopback, no paid calls. todo tests are xfail.
